name: ASRock Rack Incorporation
summary: ASRock Rack Incorporation engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of cloud computing server hardware products in Taiwan and internationally. It offers barebone products, such as all-flash storage, general purpose storage, and multi-node server products; Open 19 products; server motherboards; workstation motherboards; and accessories. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. ASRock Rack Incorporation operates as a subsidiary of ASROCK Incorporation.
